subject.title: Bug: Isolated cron job delivery.mode=announce fails with 'Channel openclaw-weixin does not support action send'

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main Weixin cron trace before queueing a core fix for this unsupported-action path?
rationale: The source evidence is strong enough to keep the issue open, but a repair could touch subtle source-reply and fallback semantics across cron channels.

options.title: Require live trace first
options.body: Keep the issue in maintainer review until a credentialed current-main Weixin cron announce run shows whether the visible source-reply path still calls `message.action=send`.

options.title: Queue source-level repair now
options.body: Allow a focused fix based on the source path, but require tests for sendText-only plugins and duplicate-suppression behavior before merge.

recommendation.title: Require live trace first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue in maintainer review until a credentialed current-main Weixin cron announce run shows whether the visible source-reply path still calls `message.action=send`.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently refactored the cron source-delivery fallback helper that owns the disputed announce plan semantics.
